## Manchester House-Hunting Weekend Plan

A focused 2-day route for a remote worker seeking a **2-bedroom apartment under £350,000** with a **30-minute public-transport commute** to Manchester city centre. This plan assumes viewings are clustered in **central, south, and east Manchester** to keep travel efficient.

## Weekend Viewing Schedule: 6 Properties, Lunch, and Comparison Time

### Saturday, 15 Aug 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- 09:00–09:30 — Travel to first viewing area; aim for a tram- or rail-linked neighborhood within the commute limit.
- 09:30–10:15 — Viewing 1: 2-bed apartment in a city-fringe development; check noise, daylight, and storage.
- 10:15–10:30 — Travel to next property.
- 10:30–11:15 — Viewing 2: 2-bed apartment near a tram stop; test the walk to the platform and local amenities.
- 11:15–11:45 — Travel buffer and quick notes.
- 11:45–12:30 — Viewing 3: 2-bed apartment in a residential block; focus on layout efficiency for remote work.
- 12:30–13:30 — Lunch break near the viewing area; use this time to compare commute notes and shortlist.
- 13:30–14:00 — Travel to afternoon cluster.
- 14:00–14:45 — Viewing 4: 2-bed apartment with good home-office potential; check broadband options and desk space.
- 14:45–15:00 — Travel to final Saturday stop.
- 15:00–15:45 — Viewing 5: 2-bed apartment with strong transport access; verify peak-time public transport frequency.
- 15:45–16:30 — Return travel and debrief; rank each property on price, commute, and condition.

### Sunday, 16 Aug 2026
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg
- 09:30–10:00 — Travel to final viewing area; prioritize a different neighborhood for comparison.
- 10:00–10:45 — Viewing 6: 2-bed apartment under budget; check lease length, service charges, and storage.
- 10:45–11:15 — Travel back to a central café or quiet workspace.
- 11:15–12:15 — Final comparison session; score all 6 properties against budget, commute, layout, and remote-work suitability.
- 12:15–12:45 — Optional agent follow-ups; request EPCs, service-charge details, and floor plans for top choices.
- 12:45–13:15 — Decision buffer; identify top 2, backup 2, and any deal-breakers.

## Property Comparison Checklist

| Viewing | Priority Check | Remote-Work Fit | Commute Fit | Budget Fit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Light, noise, storage | Desk space, socket access | Confirm tram/rail time | Under £350k |
| 2 | Build quality, layout | Quiet room for calls | Walk to station/stop | Under £350k |
| 3 | Room sizes, kitchen flow | Natural light for work | 30-min door-to-door test | Under £350k |
| 4 | Broadband, heating, windows | Dedicated workspace | Peak-time frequency | Under £350k |
| 5 | Service charges, parking | Video-call privacy | Reliable route options | Under £350k |
| 6 | Lease terms, maintenance | Flexible second bedroom | Easy city-centre access | Under £350k |

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Plan route] https://www.google.com/maps
Action: [Button: Check tram times] https://tfgm.com/
Action: [Button: Compare neighborhoods] https://www.rightmove.co.uk/
Action: [Button: Review commute options] https://www.nationalrail.co.uk/

## Sources

- Transport for Greater Manchester: https://tfgm.com/
- National Rail journey planning: https://www.nationalrail.co.uk/
- Rightmove property search: https://www.rightmove.co.uk/
